KEY RATING DRIVERS Leading Market Position, Low Costs: UltraTech has the largest share of cement-making capacity in India, around 30%, and we expect it to increase the share over next three years with rapid capacity growth. Factors that could, individually or collectively, lead to positive rating action/upgrade: - EBITDA net leverage below 1.5x on a sustained basis - Improved business mix, with segments other than grey cement contributing around 30% of revenue - Expectations of neutral or positive FCF - Strengthening of Grasim's consolidated credit profile.
